title: Reset Password
content: Users can reset their password from Settings > Security. A password reset email will be sent to the registered email address.

title: Delete Account
content: Users can permanently delete their account from Account Settings > Privacy. Deleted accounts cannot be recovered.

title: Update Profile
content: Users can update profile information such as name, phone number, and profile picture from Profile Settings.

title: Subscription Plans
content: Premium subscription plans can be managed from Billing Settings. Users can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel subscriptions.

title: Contact Support
content: Users can contact support through support@example.com or by using the Help Center contact form.

title: Refund Policy
content: Refund requests must be submitted within 7 days of purchase. Approved refunds are processed within 5 business days.

title: Two Factor Authentication
content: Users can enable two-factor authentication from Security Settings for additional account protection.

title: Change Email Address
content: Users can change their registered email address from Account Settings after verifying their identity.

title: Download Reports
content: Monthly and yearly reports can be downloaded in PDF or CSV format from the Reports Dashboard.

title: Notification Preferences
content: Users can manage email and push notification preferences from Notification Settings.
